_meta.indication: Treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), not otherwise specified, including DLBCL arising from indolent lymphoma, and high-grade B-cell lymphoma after two or more lines of systemic therapy

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, multicenter, multi-cohort, single-arm trial with a dose escalation/expansion design
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma who had received at least two prior lines of systemic therapy, including an anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint: overall response rate (ORR) determined by Lugano criteria as assessed by Independent Review Committee (IRC)
pivotal_trials.result: ORR per IRC 63% (95% CI: 55, 71), with 39% achieving complete response (95% CI: 31, 47); with median follow-up for DOR of 9.8 months, estimated median DOR was 15.5 months (95% CI: 9.7, not reached)

key_safety: Most common (>=20%) adverse reactions are cytokine release syndrome, fatigue, musculoskeletal pain, injection site reactions, pyrexia, abdominal pain, nausea, and diarrhea. CRS occurred in 51% of patients (Grade 3 in 2.5%); ICANS occurred in 6% (10/157), including one (0.6%) fatal occurrence; serious infections in 15% (fatal in 1.3%); serious adverse reactions in 54%; fatal adverse reactions in 3.8%
target_moa: Bispecific CD20-directed CD3 T-cell engager: a humanized IgG1 anti-CD20xCD3 bispecific antibody that binds CD3 on T-cells and CD20 on B-cells, promoting T-cell-dependent elimination of CD20-expressing B-cell lymphoma cells
modality: Bispecific antibody (bispecific CD20-directed CD3 T-cell engager)

boxed_warning.content: Boxed warning for Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS), including serious or life-threatening reactions, and Immune Effector Cell-Associated Neurotoxicity Syndrome (ICANS), including life-threatening and fatal reactions

rems.type: The Division of Risk Management concurred with the review team that additional REMS are not required for the safe use of epcoritamab in the indicated population

companion_dx_detail: Devices and companion diagnostic issues: Not applicable

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not presented to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because it did not raise significant efficacy or safety issues for the recommended indication

requirement.text: 4435-3: Integrated safety analysis to further characterize the long-term incidence, severity, and outcome of ICANS, neurologic toxicity, hematologic adverse events, and infections

citations.quote: 4435-5 Develop and validate an assay to evaluate the neutralizing capacity of epcoritamab anti-drug-antibodies (ADAs) detected in the patient samples by end of Q3 2023. The assay should be capable of sensitively detecting neutralizing ADAs in the presence of epcoritamab levels that are expected to be present in serum at the time of patient sampling.
